shortDescription: Published (Workshop 3786107692). Shared foundation for the Radius UI suite: one colour set, one card/hover treatment, one scroll widget, one font resolver, a Perf module, and a 268-icon shared art library — shipped once instead of copied into every mod.
body:
## What this mod is

A **library mod**. It adds no defs, no world state, and no Harmony patches. It exists so the
Radius UI suite draws with one design language instead of many forked copies of one.

Design language: flat 2.0, rounded, iOS-like, colour-forward.

Architecture of record: `_dev/RadiusUIFramework/ARCHITECTURE.md` (human-owned). Nothing in
`_dev/` ships.

## Status: PUBLISHED

- **Steam Workshop: 3786107692** - published 2026-08-18, verified live (app 294100).
- **Git: `Astryls/Radius-UI-Framework`** (private), branch `main`. Tag
  `source-20260818-224857` pins the full pre-publish source snapshot.
- **Local backup:** `D:\Rimworld\Radius UI Framework\20260818-224857\`.
- Licence: MIT.

Currently in **build mode** - `Source/` is restored and the build is green (0 warnings).

## Publish contract (GLOBAL_RULES §6)

The shipped folder is runtime-only: `About/`, `Assemblies/`, `Languages/`, `Textures/`,
`LICENSE`. Build is Release with `DebugType=none`, so no `.pdb` and no Harmony DLL ship.

Verified gates at publish: zero em/en dashes in player-facing text; `Preview.png` exactly
1280x720; 268 declared texture paths reconcile exactly against 268 files on disk, with nothing
missing and nothing unreferenced in either direction.

**Outstanding:** `About/ModIcon.png` is still missing, and `RadiusUI.Settings.PreviewCard` is
an orphan keyed string (defined, never referenced).

## Texture library (268 icons + 12 aliases, 18 categories)

Imported from five source mods - HUD, Health Tab, Colonist Bar, Modern Quest Menu, True RPG
Inventory. 296 source files became 280, then 268 after a human duplicate review. All are
byte-for-byte copies: no resampling, no recolouring.

Namespaced under `Textures/RadiusUI/` because `ContentFinder` returns the *last-loaded* match,
so an un-namespaced sibling in a consumer would silently shadow it. Consumers must delete their
local copies, not merely stop referencing them.

Regrouped by **meaning**, not by the per-mod folder accidents the art grew up in, so the folder
carries the category and the prefix is dropped from every name.

### The art is three tiers, not one family

Only tier 1 can be re-themed:

- **Glyphs** - flat white RGB, all information in alpha. Tinted via `Palette`/accent.
- **Illustrations (`Anatomy/`)** - shaded beige art. Never tinted.
- **Semantic markers (`Marker/`)** - colour *is* the meaning; mapped to the semantic ramp,
  never to an arbitrary accent. Hand-synced to the palette: if the ramp changes, those 8 PNGs
  must be re-authored.

### Aliases are a hard requirement

12 names were retired in the duplicate review. `IconSet` must expose all 12 as aliases or
consumer call sites break. Two ordered sets are partly alias-backed and must still present
their full width: `Squad/` ships 5 files but offers 8 emblem slots; `Reminder/` ships 7 but
offers 8 picker slots.

`Action/LockOpen` and `Action/LockClosed` scored 0.927 similarity but were deliberately kept
apart - they are a **state pair**, and collapsing them would leave the UI unable to show locked
vs unlocked.

## Components

- `Tokens/` - `Palette` (+ Health, Ideology partials), `Metrics`. Pure values.
- `Chrome/CardChrome` - the rounded card, border and hover wash.
- `Widgets/FlatScroll` - the suite scroll view.
- `Icons/` - `RadiusIcon` (art tier lives here), `IconSet` + generated per-tier partials.
- `Text/RadiusFont` - framework-owned font resolution and measurement.
- `Settings/` - `RadiusTheme`, `RadiusThemeSettings`, `RadiusFrameworkMod`, `SettingsPage`.
- `Compat/ModCompat`, `Perf/DefTable` - added by a parallel session.

### `Perf/` - hot-path utilities

Extracted from HUD and Colonist Bar, the suite's two true per-frame drawers, before they
migrate and lose the optimisations they already had: `FrameGate`, `Throttle`, `TextMemo`,
`ScratchText`, `SnapshotTable`, `IdMap`, `PooledWindowState`, `ViewCull`, `PatchGuard`.
Main-thread only and deliberately not thread safe.

`RadiusFont.Size/Height/Width` were **not** memoized despite the docs claiming otherwise - they
now route through `TextMemo` behind unchanged signatures and identical values. `TextMemo` uses
generational two-dictionary eviction (hot entries promoted, no periodic recompute spike) and
also memoizes ellipsis fitting.

`RadiusThemeSettings.refreshMult` (0.5..4, default 1) backs `Throttle.EveryScaled`; higher is
slower and cheaper. No settings-screen control yet.

## Binding rules for framework edits (§13)

Additive only; never change the value behind an existing name; missing token means add a new
one; **rebuild every consumer after any framework rebuild** and hash-verify their game-side
copies; the 12 icon aliases are permanent. Framework `Source/` receives concurrent pushes - always
re-read a file from disk immediately before editing it.

## Known issue

Game-side `RimWorld/Mods/RadiusUIFramework` is a **real directory, not a symlink**, and its DLL
has drifted stale. Consumers are symlinked and stay live, so the running game can pair new
consumer DLLs with an old framework DLL - the MissingMethodException setup §13 rule 4 exists to
prevent. Needs a sync pass.
